苍莽山林往上，山路愈发陡峻。

云雾自山巅垂落，缠在古松崖壁之间，白茫茫一片，把前路遮得若隐若现。山风卷着刺骨寒意，夹着浓重阴煞与咒诵余音，沉沉压在林间，让人胸口发闷，道心都隐隐震颤。

小队众人收拾妥当，踏着石阶残路，一步步逼近那座残破古观。

古观依山而建，青砖院墙大半坍塌，山门歪斜倾颓，屋顶瓦片零落殆尽，荒草长到半腰，枯藤缠满梁柱，满目荒废破败，透着百年无人的沧桑死寂。

可偏偏就是这样一座废弃古观，周身萦绕着一层黑紫色煞气，缓慢流转，笼罩整座道观方圆百丈。观内隐隐有沉闷咒音起伏，与山巅祭坛的诵咒声遥遥呼应，地气拧绞，阴煞沉聚，绝非普通荒观。

“果然被改成了中转祭台。”胡九郎驻足，眸光凝望着残观轮廓，天眼通透云雾，将内里格局尽收眼底，“原本是关外老道留下的修道清修之地，地基引龙脉清气聚灵，如今被东瀛阴阳师篡改阵纹，倒转地脉，化作锁煞聚阴的邪阵节点。”

范梦雪缓步上前，雷木法尺轻握，周身雷光微敛，警惕感应观内气息：“观中煞气层次比幽谷、密林高出一截，至少有一名高阶阴阳师坐镇，而且蓄养了大批式神，布成了列队守阵，不是零散埋伏，是规整军阵。”

被禁锢修为的织田美子被李二牛押在身后，面色漠然，眼神却藏着一丝阴翳：“古观是上山最后一道外关，阴阳寮派了大咒师渡边苍玄坐镇，麾下养了整百式神，布四象锁煞阵，你们就算闯过密林忍阵，也跨不过这座残观。”

“渡边苍玄？”林佳立刻在脑海里调取749局存档资料，“东瀛阴阳寮老牌大咒师，精通式神驯养、阴阵排布、镇魂献祭，实力远超之前遇到的所有阴阳师，是山巅祭坛之下的镇守主力。”

杨瑞打开随身木箱，取出一叠新的镇煞符、破阵玉牌，分给众人：“观内阵纹改了地脉走向，阴气倒灌，普通符箓威力会被削弱，每人多带两枚纯阳玉牌，稳住自身灵气，别被逆地煞气扰了心神。”

钱丹指尖轻捻，袖中飞出十余只噬毒蛊、镇邪蛊，四散浮空，绕着古观外围盘旋一圈，很快折返回来，蛊体微微躁动：“观里不仅有式神、咒师，还布了地底蛊穴，九菊一派在这里暗养凶蛊，和阴阳阵纹融为一体，一旦开战，蛊潮会从地下涌出，前后夹击。”

王欣欣、茉沫对视一眼，各自摸出暗器囊，补满淬毒银针、透骨飞镖、困魂软索，神色冷冽：“管他什么大咒师、百鬼式神，一路杀上来，不差这一关。”

李安琪抬手，周遭山石灵气悄然流转，在小队脚下凝成一层石质防御气罩，随时可以延展成壁垒、石墙，封锁道观出入口。

众人阵型重新微调，依旧以胡九郎居中主阵，范梦雪雷法护法，唐门姐妹左右掠杀，李安琪御物布防，钱丹控蛊制衡，杨瑞法器策应，林佳统筹战局，李二牛守后押人。

Going up through the vast forest, the mountain road becomes steeper.

Clouds and mist drooped from the top of the mountain, entangled between the ancient pines and cliffs, and a vast expanse of white obscured the road ahead.The mountain wind carried a biting chill, mixed with the thick evil spirit and the lingering sound of mantras, and pressed heavily in the forest, making people feel tight in the chest and trembling in the Taoist heart.

The team packed up and walked on the broken stone steps, approaching the dilapidated ancient temple step by step.

The ancient temple was built against the mountain. Most of the green brick courtyard walls have collapsed, the mountain gate is crooked and slumped, the roof tiles are scattered, the grass has grown to half the waist, and withered vines are wrapped around the beams and columns. It is desolate and dilapidated, showing the vicissitudes of life that have not been used for hundreds of years.

But it happened to be such an abandoned ancient temple, surrounded by a layer of black and purple evil spirit, slowly flowing, covering the entire Taoist temple with a radius of hundreds of feet.Inside the temple, there are faint sounds of dull mantras rising and falling, echoing the chanting of mantras from the altar on the top of the mountain. The earth's energy is twisting and the evil spirits are gathering. It is by no means an ordinary desolate temple.

"Sure enough, it was changed into a transit altar." Hu Jiulang stopped and stared at the outline of Cangguan. His heavenly eyes penetrated the clouds and mist and took in the inner layout. "It was originally a place of monastic cultivation left by the old Taoist outside the pass. The foundation attracted the dragon veins to clear the air and gather the spirits. Now, the Japanese Onmyoji has tampered with the formation pattern, reversed the earth veins, and turned it into an evil formation node that locks evil spirits and gathers yin."

Fan Mengxue stepped forward slowly, lightly holding the Thunder Wood Ruler, and the thunder light around her body was slightly restrained. She carefully sensed the aura in the temple: "The level of evil energy in the temple is higher than that of the deep valley and dense forest. There is at least one high-level Onmyoji who is stationed in the temple, and he has cultivated a large number of shikigami. They have formed a formation to defend the formation. It is not a scattered ambush, but a regular military formation."

Oda Miko, whose cultivation was imprisoned, was being escorted behind by Li Erniu. Her face was indifferent, but there was a hint of gloom in her eyes: "The ancient temple is the last outer gate on the mountain. The Yin and Yang Lao sent the great spell master Watanabe Sogen to take charge. He has a hundred shikigami under his command and has set up a four-image lock formation. Even if you can break through the dense forest Ninja Formation, you will not be able to cross this ruined temple."

"Watanabe Sogen?" Lin Jia immediately retrieved the archived data of the 749th game in his mind, "The veteran great spell master of Japan's Onmyojia is proficient in shikigami domestication, arrangement of Yin formations, and soul-suppressing sacrifices. His strength far exceeds all the Onmyoji he has encountered before. He is the main guard under the altar on the mountain top."

Yang Rui opened the wooden box he carried with him, took out a new stack of evil-suppressing talismans and array-breaking jade tokens, and distributed them to everyone: "The formation patterns in the temple have changed the direction of the earth's veins, and the yin energy has poured in. The power of ordinary talismans will be weakened. Each person should bring two more pure yang jade tokens to stabilize his own spiritual energy, and don't be disturbed by the evil energy that goes against the earth."

Qian Dan lightly twisted his fingertips, and more than a dozen poison-eating Gu and evil-suppressing Gu flew out of his sleeves. They scattered in the air, circled around the outside of the ancient temple, and soon turned back. The Gu body was slightly restless: "There are not only shikigami and spell masters in the temple, but also underground Gu holes. The Jiuju faction secretly raises vicious Gu here, integrating with the Yin and Yang formations. Once a war starts, the tide of Gu will emerge from the ground and attack front and back."

Wang Xinxin and Mo Mo looked at each other, each took out their hidden weapon pouches and filled them with poison-quenching silver needles, bone-piercing darts, and soul-trapping soft ropes. Their expressions were cold: "It doesn't matter what a great spell master or a hundred ghosts shikigami are. Kill them all the way, and you won't miss this level."

Li Anqi raised her hand, and the spiritual energy of the surrounding rocks quietly circulated, forming a stone defensive air shield at the feet of the team. It could be extended into a barrier or stone wall at any time to block the entrance and exit of the Taoist temple.

The everyone's formation was fine-tuned again, with Hu Jiulang still in the center and the main formation, Fan Mengxue's thunder protection, the Tang Clan sisters raiding and killing, Li Anqi's defensive objects, Qian Dan's gu control, Yang Rui's magical weapons, Lin Jia's coordination, and Li Erniu's defense.
